LANDED SIGNATURES (provider-pause-ledger.ts / provider-pause-contracts.ts):
- `readProviderPause(store: SqliteEventStore, projectId: string, provider: string, now: string): ProviderPauseRecordV1 | null`. `now` is an ISO STRING, not ms (Date.parse'd internally; a non-finite parse returns null rather than parking the fleet). - `ProviderPauseRecordV1 = { cause: SeatExitCause | null; projectId; provider; resetAt: string; since: string; version: "moe-provider-pause/1" }`. `SeatExitCause = { lastLine: string | null; workItemId: string }`. NOTE cause is NULLABLE (a CLEAR writes cause:null) and cause.lastLine is NULLABLE -> the view maps both to "" (step 7 arm).
- `recordProviderPause(store, { cause: SeatExitCause|null, projectId, provider, resetAt, since })` -> `{ok:true, record, replayed} | {ok:false, code:"EXPECTED_VERSION_CONFLICT"|"PROVIDER_PAUSE_RECORD_INVALID"}`. commandId derived from (projectId, provider, since) so a repeat replays.
- `resetAt`/`since` must match ISO_INSTANT or the record decode refuses.
